blocks.orig: This excursion is a nice combination of nature, culture and activity. First, you visit a snake park that hosts all the snake species of Tanzania and learn more about these fascinating animals. Then onwards to the Maasai Museum, where the Maasai are happy to elaborate on their culture and how they build their houses. Last but not least, kids and brave adults can hop on a camel for a short ride around the park.
blocks.html: This outing nicely combines nature, culture and activity. To start, you go to a snake park that keeps every snake species of Tanzania and find out more about these remarkable animals. Next comes the Maasai Museum, where the Maasai gladly tell you about their culture and the way they build their homes. Finally, children and daring adults can climb onto a camel for a short ride around the park.
